title: Optimize an eventhouse: caching, retention, materialized views and query shape
objective_text: Choose the eventhouse policies and query patterns that keep recent queries fast and old data under control.
scenario: Fernbrook stores sensor readings in an eventhouse. Dashboards look at recent days, auditors want old data gone after three years, and the same aggregation runs on every tile.
verifies: You can pick the right setting or pattern for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can apply it in Fabric: nothing is set up or run here. Doing it on a real item is FABRIC VERIFIED work.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.
